description: Read-only. Recent individual taps, newest first: when, which link, platform, channel, in-app browser, where Strait sent it (sent_to), and the app open and install it led to (opened_at, open_kind, installed_at, match_method). Default: the last hour. Use it to check that a test tap was recorded and what happened to it. Reads the taps export (an owner's or admin's key).

from.description: Inclusive start: 2026-10-01, an ISO date-time or epoch ms

to.description: Exclusive end, same formats; default now

name: list_taps
title: List recent taps
